home.title: Home
home.tagline: Smart time tracking for work hours, pay, and statistics.
home.description: Hours Calculator helps you log start and end times, handle overnight shifts, estimate pay from an hourly rate, review charts and summaries, and import or export CSV files. The app supports English, Dutch, and Arabic and works as an installable PWA.
features: Track daily time entries with automatic duration and overnight shift handling.
See weekly totals, pay estimates, and detailed statistics.
Import and export CSV files compatible with your records.
Sync securely to your account across phones and desktops when signed in.
Use offline on this device; data is stored locally until you sign in to back up.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introLead: Hours Calculator (“the app”, “we”) is a web application at
privacy.introRest: that helps you track working hours, calculate durations (including overnight shifts), estimate pay, view statistics, and import or export CSV files. This privacy policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your choices.
privacy.contactLead: Questions about this privacy policy or your data:

collect.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: Depending on how you use the app, we may process the following data:

bullets.label: Account information
bullets.text: (when you sign in): email address, display name, first and last name (if you provide them), and authentication identifiers from Firebase Authentication.

bullets.label: Google Sign-In
bullets.text: (optional): if you choose “Continue with Google”, Google provides basic profile information (such as name and email) according to your Google account settings and our OAuth scope. We do not receive your Google password.

bullets.label: Time-tracking data
bullets.text: : dates, start and end times, optional per-entry pay amounts, hourly rate, currency preference, date-range filters, and related entries you create in the app.

bullets.label: Technical data on your device
bullets.text: : data stored locally in your browser (for example localStorage) so the app can work offline and remember your settings before or without signing in.

paragraphsAfter: We do not intentionally collect sensitive categories of personal data (such as health or government ID numbers). Please do not enter information you do not want stored with your account or on your device.

use.title: How we use your information
bullets: Provide core functionality: tracking hours, totals, statistics, and CSV import/export.
Authenticate you and sync your data across devices when you use a signed-in account.
Maintain security, prevent abuse, and improve reliability of the service.
Respond to support or privacy requests you send us.
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We do not use your data for third-party advertising.

bullets.label: On your device
bullets.text: : when you use the app without signing in, or before sync completes, entries and preferences may be kept in browser local storage on that device only.

bullets.label: Cloud storage
bullets.text: (signed-in users): account and time-entry data are stored in Google Firebase (Authentication and Cloud Firestore) in secured databases tied to your user ID. Access rules require you to be signed in as that user to read or write your data.

thirdParty.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: We rely on the following service providers to operate the app:
These providers process data on our behalf under their terms and only as needed to deliver the service.

bullets.label: Google Firebase
bullets.text: — authentication, database, and hosting infrastructure. Privacy policy:

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: The app uses browser local storage and similar technologies to remember your language, entries, and preferences. Firebase Authentication may use cookies or local session storage to keep you signed in. You can clear site data in your browser settings; doing so may sign you out and remove unsynced local entries.

retention.title: Data retention
paragraphs: We retain account and synced time-entry data for as long as your account exists or as needed to provide the service. If you delete your account or ask us to delete your data, we will remove or anonymize it within a reasonable time, subject to legal or backup retention requirements.

rights.title: Your rights and choices
bullets: You may use export features to download your time entries as CSV.
You may stop using the app and clear browser data for this site at any time.
You may request access, correction, or deletion of account data by contacting us (see below). If you use Google Sign-In, you can also manage connected apps in your Google account.

children.title: Children
paragraphs: The app is not directed at children under 13 (or the minimum age in your country). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

changes.title: Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. We will revise the “Last updated” date above. Continued use of the app after changes means you accept the updated policy.
